The equation for the reaction of aqueous calcium nitrate and aqueous sodium hydroxide is
shown.
Ca(NO3)2(aq)  +  2NaOH(aq)  →  Ca(OH)2(s)  +  2NaNO3(aq)
Which process is used to remove calcium hydroxide from the mixture?
A
chromatography
B
crystallisation
C
distillation
D
filtration
subject: Chemistry
